polarized_karyotype_calls.description: One row per (sample, candidate) — same shape as unpolarized_karyotype_calls but the 0/1/2 axis now carries direction: 0 = reference-like, 2 = derived/inverted-like. Confidence + method are propagated; original_karyotype preserved.

original_karyotype.description: The pre-polarization class from unpolarized_karyotype_calls — kept for audit.

polarity.description: `flipped` when polarization swapped 0 ↔ 2; `unchanged` when reference already matched class 0; `unknown` when polarity_source couldn't resolve.

polarity_summary.description: Per-candidate polarity outcome — what the polarizer decided and why. Always emitted.

ref_dosage.description: Reference dosage that decided the call, when polarity_source = reference_match.
